name: base_4c
description: Stock configurable Vortex machine, 4 cores x 4 warps x 16 threads, shared L2, atomics (A + Zacas). Base-machine functional check.

sources.L2_ENABLE: atomics from several cores must meet at a shared level
sources.EXT_A_ENABLE: atomics are needed by any cross-thread program
sources.EXT_ZACAS_ENABLE: without it CAS is an lr/sc loop that hangs divergent warps
sources.ICALL_SPLIT_ENABLE: SimX only: a call whose target differs across lanes runs one target at a time and rejoins at the return; the compiler emits it as one jalr (wrong results, simt_div modes 0, 9). Kernels build with -fno-optimize-sibling-calls
sources.DBG_STALL_TIMEOUT: 10M cycles (stock 200k with L2): many warps queued on atomics to one word wait longer than 200k cycles without any hang
